purpose: Patch-level corpus for classifyFailure. Each entry is driven through real checkCandidate or recorded CI facts, the real materializer, replayHeldoutCandidate and runHeldoutBase on the local bwrap runner, then classifyFailure.

entries.provenance: Fixture 576. Base docs/operations/human-review.md is blob c90382b at gate b2367de. The candidate file is blob b3d76b1 and the two published checks are the exact bytes of candidate 73628e5 (sha256 8082812640e3 and 52222637a3ee, matching diagnose-576.stdout). The original canary comment is dropped; the store plants a fresh one.

criteria.text: Quick reference follows the introduction and precedes Inspect the handoff
The existing owner merge/close section is byte-for-byte unchanged

ci.note: CI 41580633761 ran the pre-#577 materializer. Its failure path and ignoredChanges are recorded in diagnose-576.md; its counts are not, so the test takes them from the legacy gate replay.

entries.rationale: diagnose-576.md: the gate kept main's documentation, so the correct patch failed only on the gate tree. The full candidate tree passes all five tests. No repair can fix a gate defect.

entries.provenance: Same inputs as 576-docs-pre-577-gate, read by a controller that already has #577.
entries.rationale: The current materializer overlays the documentation, so its ignoredChanges is empty while the historical receipt lists the doc. The parity check stops before any tree comparison can blame the candidate.

entries.provenance: Fixture 561's recorded S7 check bytes (../561/v2/s7.test.mjs.txt) on its recorded base skills/README.md at f42ab42. The patch is synthetic: it inserts a correct Human review section before the provenance table.

criteria.text: S7: existing descriptions, provenance table, licenses and links remain unchanged

entries.rationale: S7 is a preservation check that requires the new heading, so it fails on the unchanged base, and its whole-document equality rejects a correct section placed before the table.

entries.provenance: Fixture 568's recorded S4 check bytes (../568/v2/s4.test.mjs.txt) on its recorded base docs/operations/viewer.md at 265e1b7. The patch is synthetic: it appends a correct Troubleshooting startup subsection.

criteria.text: existing startup and privacy guidance remains available

entries.rationale: S4 asserts guidance the base never had, so the preservation check fails on the unchanged base. A correct troubleshooting patch cannot make it pass.

entries.provenance: Minimal synthetic source patch. The ticket asks value() to return two; the patch returns three.
entries.rationale: The check is red on the base by assertion, the preservation check passes, and the candidate fails the same assertion on both trees.

entries.provenance: Minimal synthetic source patch that renames the export the ticket requires, so the check fails to load.
entries.rationale: After a qualified base, a candidate-side load error that both trees reproduce is a candidate defect.

entries.provenance: Minimal synthetic patch that adds an .npmrc, which the gate rejects before any check runs.
entries.rationale: npmrc_changed is a recognized candidate-policy early abort in the closed table.
